instruction: Use the keyboard shortcut to recover the tripadvisor.com tab that was just closed.

metadata.explanation: Task asks agent to use keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+T) to reopen the TripAdvisor tab. The evaluator checks all 3 URLs are open using is_expected_tabs metric with get_open_tabs_info getter. No custom functions required - standard Chrome tab management evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: get_open_tabs_info (chrome.py:623) correctly retrieves all open Chrome tabs with URLs using Playwright CDP connection
Metric logic correct: is_expected_tabs (chrome.py:120) correctly compares expected vs actual URLs using order-independent are_lists_equal function with compare_urls
Expected values correct: All 3 URLs (lonelyplanet, airbnb, tripadvisor) are semantically correct for this task
Coverage complete: Evaluator verifies the core requirement - that tripadvisor tab is present after agent action
Order-independent comparison: are_lists_equal checks for presence of all URLs regardless of tab order, correctly handling the case where reopened tab may appear in different position

Minor limitation: Evaluator cannot verify the specific METHOD used (keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+T vs manual navigation to URL), but this is a practical limitation of outcome-based verification rather than a logical flaw
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding metadata to track that instruction specifies keyboard shortcut method, even though evaluator can only verify outcome
